# limited test detection

Files are considered test files only if the filename contains '.test.' or '.spec.' and test calls are recognized only when the callee name is exactly 'test' or 'it' and the first argument is a string. Tests using other naming conventions, wrappers, or frameworks will not be detected and their related test facts will be missing.
